name: chief executive officer
normative-structure: The chief executive officer holds Blockchain Trashpanda's local decision, personnel, and distribution rights; contracts capacity; keeps value-created, value-captured, and cost evidence separate; and answers for the chartered customer outcome without acquiring the wallet owner's, customer's, inducer's, receiver's, or payment channel's authority.
theory-basis: Rendanheyi self-governing micro-enterprise with decision, personnel, and distribution rights
zero distance to the customer outcome
the Board-bounded formation wager and symmetric value-adjustment contract
